Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I'll lead off with the one issue I've had with the grill: I've ruined several pieces of food trying to get used to a grill that heats quickly, evenly, and adjusts properly.  After a couple of "disposable" grills that last two or three seasons, I finally sprung for a Weber.  Right out of the gate, it heats to 150 degrees higher than my last grill.  The small(er) cooking area of the two-burner really doesn't matter because it heats more or less evenly across the whole surface, so there aren't spots that you can't use.  I've been using it almost daily and the improvement in the overall quality of the meals from it as I'm dialing in my ability to use it are some of the best things I've ever made.

tl;dr: If you don't have a Weber, get one.  It's better.
Results.Title: Getting used to a REAL grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
